description: Runs up to 10 tracks through one set of settings in a single call. Every track needs a credit or a free run, so N tracks need N of them. With album_mode on (the default) loudness is matched across the set: the loudest track lands on the target and the others keep their level differences, so a quiet interlude is not pushed up to single-track level. Caps set by this server, for memory: 10 tracks, 100 MB per file and 300 MB per call. Long albums take minutes, so fewer tracks per call work better. One job id comes back per track; poll each with get_job. dry_run=true reports the planned charge and settings first.

album_mode.description: Matches loudness across the batch so the tracks keep their relative levels. Defaults to true; set false for unrelated singles.

audio_urls.description: Track addresses as public https links, listed in album order.

bitrate.description: Kbps setting. MP3: 128, 192, 256 or 320. OPUS: 128 or 192.

dry_run.description: Planning only: reports the expected charge and settings without rendering and without fetching any file.

out_format.description: Container and encoding of the rendered file.

remove_watermark.description: Runs AI artifact cleanup before mastering as well.

style.description: Name of the preset applied to every track; list_presets gives the options.

target_lufs.description: Goal for the loudest track when album mode is on.

name: batch_master

tracks.description: job_id, filename, source_url, target_lufs and album_lufs_offset as APPLIED by the server

title: Multi-track run with shared settings
